messages.snippet: Colleagues, The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday between 22:00 and 02:00
messages.subject: [IT] Scheduled DMS maintenance this Saturday 22:00-02:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday between 22:00 and 02:00 for scheduled maintenance and security patching. Please save and close any documents before then. Email will be unaffected.

Thank you,
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
